in_sanskrit.name: Mohideen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mohideen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mohideen is a name derived from the Arabic word 'mohid' meaning 'moon' and the Persian suffix '-een' meaning 'god'. This name signifies the presence of the divine being in the form of the moon, which is considered a powerful symbol of change, renewal, and protection.
